name: Ishioka (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ishioka city emblem in white: a disc crossed by a diagonal white stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Ishioka, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 29 June 2018; the emblem dates from 11 February 1954.

features.role: Ishioka city emblem — a disc crossed by a diagonal white stroke
